messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"APMO","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"APMO","units":[{"chapter":29,"text":"for his food.\" And God bade Adam go in and take sweet spices and fragrant herbs from paradise","source_ref":"29:5"},{"chapter":29,"text":"and seeds for his food. And the angels let him go and he took four kinds: crocus and nard and calamus and cinnamon and the other seeds for his food: and, after taking these, he went out of","source_ref":"29:6"},{"chapter":29,"text":"paradise. And we were on the earth.","source_ref":"29:7"},{"chapter":30,"text":"Now then, my children, I have shown you the way in which we were deceived; and do ye guard yourselves from transgressing against the good.'","source_ref":"30:1"},{"chapter":31,"text":"And when Eve had said this in the midst of her sons, while Adam was lying ill and bound to die","source_ref":"31:1"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 29:5, 29:6, 29:7, 30:1, 31:1.
